arStrings.szText: BATTLE PASS

The Battle Pass consists of 1 Standard and 3 Premium Reliquaries. Premium Reliquaries can be purchased with  {icon:CurrencyIcon, 2.0}  {c_highlight}Platinum{/c} individually or as part of a bundle for additional savings or rewards.
WELCOME TO RELIQUARIES
The new home of the Battle Pass that lets you choose the order you pursue the rewards. However, Reliquaries are more than just the Battle Pass. Be on the lookout for special Event Reliquaries.
CLAIM REWARDS

The {c_highlight}Premium Battle Pass Bundle{/c} unlocks all 3 Premium Reliquaries at a discount, while the {c_highlight}Deluxe Battle Pass Bundle{/c} gives instant access to the bonus armor set and 2 additional rewards you won’t find in the other Reliquaries.
EARN FAVOR
Fill up your Favor bar by killing monsters and completing quests. Each time you fill the bar, you’ll earn 1 {icon:ReliquaryFavorIcon, 2.0} {c_highlight}Favor{/c} Token.
FAVOR CAP
You can hold up to 99 Favor Tokens. Once you reach that number, you must spend them before you can earn more. Favor Tokens, up to the cap of 99, will carry over each season.
Use the Favor Tokens you earn to claim rewards in the Battle Pass.
Favor Cap Reached. Max 99. Spend tokens to earn more.

RELICS OF AZEROTH EVENT

CLAIM REWARDS

The Relics of Azeroth {c_highlight}Premium Reliquary{/c} includes several {c_highlight}free{/c} Azeroth themed cosmetics for you to claim and can be purchased with  {icon:CurrencyIcon, 2.0}  {c_highlight}Platinum{/c} to gain access to premium cosmetics and the completion {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} Bonus reward.
Slay Elite and Champion monsters to earn {icon:Event_Currency_Cocoa, 1.8} {c_highlight}Relics of Azeroth Currency{/c}.
Spend your earned currency to unlock rewards from Azeroth. Claim them all to unlock {c_important}Hakkar the Soulflayer{/c} as a pet!
The {c_highlight}Overwatch Reliquary{/c} includes themed cosmetics including Emblems, Transmogs and a Pet completion {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} bonus reward.
OVERWATCH
Slay {c_rare}Elite{/c} and {c_magic}Champion{/c} monsters to earn {icon:Event_Currency_Overwatch, 1.8} {c_important}Eyes of the Overwatch{/c} currency.
EARN EYES OF THE OVERWATCH
Spend your earned currency to unlock rewards from the Overwatch Reliquary. Claim them all to unlock {c_important}Fox Spirit{/c} as a pet!
